product.ta-alphatronic-pc16.summary: The PC16 kept the compact Alphatronic PC format and moved to an 8088 with modular video.
product.ta-alphatronic-pc16.history: Triumph-Adler returned to the PC’s integrated keyboard for office use. The Homecomputermuseum places its introduction in 1985. Computermuseum Mannheim gives 1983, which also appears in the record of a unit with BTX.
product.ta-alphatronic-pc16.technical.co: The system offered different display modules. A CDA 026 unit equipped for Bildschirmtext (BTX) survives.
product.ta-alphatronic-pc16.technical.ve: BluMach has no runnable profile for this model.
product.ta-alphatronic-pc16.technical.li: The system and keyboard ROMs match MAME, which uses a character generator from another machine. The original and a boot test are pending. MAME marks the PC16 as not working.
product.ta-alphatronic-pc16.technical.so: Alphatronic PC 16 Typ CDA 026 mit Btx-Modul · MSPT
